answer.rationale: The 94% line utilization and 14-day non-renewing deadline make a primary-vendor switch materially risky despite the low-cost quote meeting the spend mandate. First pursue an accelerated incumbent negotiation using market benchmarking and a multi-year/volume commitment to seek the required reduction while preserving proven integration and delivery continuity. The incumbent's ability to reach the full 18% target remains unverified; verify the archived benchmarking record before committing.
